QUESTIONS "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;60 year old female who came with complaints of shortness of breath which were intermittent and increased since the last 2 months after clinical examination was diagnosed with acute exacerbation of bronchial asthma\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1. Cardiac Asthma :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn a case which may present as intermittent shortness of breath can also be a case of cardiac asthma and clinical examination should be done to differentiate cardiac asthma from bronchial asthma\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECardiac asthma is not a true form of asthma; it is a manifestation of congestive heart failure. It results from the accumulation of fluid in the lungs due to impaired cardiac function.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe differentiating factor of bronchial asthma is it's intermittent nature.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2. Action of Biguanides:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E3. Role of adipokines in Insulin resistance:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003EAdipose tissue acts as an endocrine organ to secrete 'adipokines' and works with the liver and brain to maintain an energy hemostasis.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003EThese adipokines have varying effects—some exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, while others contribute to harmful inflammation.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThey exacerbate inflammation, insulin resistance, and glucose\/insulin metabolism in adipose tissues and other peripheral tissues such as the liver, muscle, pancreas, and blood vessels. In particular, FABP, ASP, RBP4, and lipocalin-2 are correlated with inflammation, obesity, and insulin resistance.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESource : https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6617388\/\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOSCE points and questions common for all that all must be prepared to answer in their patients:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EQ:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhat bothers your patient the most and what are his active concerns?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EList the problems in your patient in order of patient priorities and requirements\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1. The most debilitating part about the patients illness is her inability to eat and sleep peacefully. The constant shortness of breath was not only a physical challenge but also worrisome for her mentally.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2. After which her ability to take care of herself is affected. She has mentioned that she needs to people to take her to the bathroom.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3.Her ability to do household chores is affected. She is also not able to take care of and cook for her son and daughter in law.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EQ:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESequence of events :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhat was your patient's hourly workflow before the illness and how did it change after?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBefore the Illness:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1. Morning Routine:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Woke up at 6 AM and engaged in household activities, including dishwashing and cooking breakfast.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Breakfast comprised rice and curry, followed by cleaning the house and socializing with neighbors.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2. Daytime Activities:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Lunch around 2 PM, followed by cleaning and preparing food for son and daughter-in-law upon their return from work.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Quality family time in the evening, dinner at 8 PM, and sound sleep by 9 or 10 PM.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3. Sleep Quality:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Enjoyed a restful sleep, waking up refreshed in the morning.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter the Illness:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1. Altered Wake-up Time:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Wakes up 2 hours later at 8 AM and struggles with reduced energy levels.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2. Limited Physical Activity:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Inability to perform household chores due to exertion, struggles with standing for prolonged periods.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Reduced food intake, with difficulty in managing daily tasks and taking care of family.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3. Progressive Decline:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Gradual deterioration, leading to dependence on assistance for basic activities, including using the washroom.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Nighttime disturbances, waking up multiple times due to cough, resulting in morning sluggishness\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4. Impact on Sleep Quality:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Sleep quality deteriorated post-illness, marked by disruptions during the night and a less refreshed feeling upon waking up.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EQ:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhat are the current diagnostic and therapeutic gaps and what more can the treating team do to fill those gaps?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;1. Telemedicine and Remote Monitoring:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Utilizing telemedicine for regular check-ins and remote monitoring devices to track respiratory parameters.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis can improve patient compliance, facilitate early intervention, and reduce the need for in person hospital visits.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2. Gaps in Patient Education and Self-Management:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- We should patient education on recognising asthma triggers, importance of lifestyle modifications and the importance of adherence to the prescribed treatment plan.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- Education regarding obesity and it's relation to CAD, DM2 and metabolic syndrome. Also teaching them regarding a balanced diet and the need for taking walks, getting aerobic activity everyday.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3. Diagnosis of an SOB case :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- A\u0026nbsp; thorough examination of respiratory and CVS examination to be done.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4. Updating ourselves to the new GINA guidelines for the management of Bronchial Asthma.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESome updates include : -\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-\u0026nbsp; avoiding excess use of SABAs\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- new 'tracks' for management of Adolescent and Adult asthma\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- taking into consideration modifiable risk factors.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESource :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/respiratory.medicinetoday.com.au\/rmt\/2023\/september\/feature-article\/gina-2023-report-whats-new-asthma-management\u003C\/p\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/abhigna97.blogspot.com\/feeds\/1476037397331626905\/comments\/default","title":"Post \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe following E-log aims at discussing our patient de-identified health data shared after taking the guardian's signed consent.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHere we discuss our individual patient problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve the patients clinical problem with current best evidence based input.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis E-log also reflects my patient's centered online learning portfolio.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"Patient Clinical Data Analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and providing treatment best to our skills and wisdom.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E------------------\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is a 60 year old housewife, resident of narketpally\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003EChief complaint:\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShortness of breath since 2 months\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EChest pain 10 bays back\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHOPI :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 2 months ago when she developed shortness of breath which was insidious in onset, intermittent in nature. It was exacerbated with activity (grade 1 mmrc) and relieved by taking rest and taking medication :\u0026nbsp; cetirizine and rotahaler fluticasone.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAcute exacerbation since 3 to 4 days of sob grade 2 mmrc relieved by taking medication. Associated with dry cough which is increased at night associated with sore throat since 2 days which was relieved on medication. Aggrevated by cold weather. not associated with fever. not associated with sneezing.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPAST HISTORY :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes mellitus on admission. Not a k\/c\/o\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHTN, TB, Epilepsy, thyroid disorders.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFAMILY HISTORY: Elder sister : k\/c\/o Asthma since early childhood.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet : Mixed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite: Normal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel \u0026amp; Bladder: regular\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep : Adequate\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAddictions :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• none\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETREATMENT HISTORY :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EUsage of tab. C\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is c\/c\/c well oriented to time, place and person.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EModerately built and nourished.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPallor \u0026amp;
